svg.title: Rainy City Window — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A moody city viewed through rain-streaked glass, warm windows, and a leafy sill. Full-color library preview; open the SVG to use the numbered mandala-style worksheet. Click a region to apply its suggested color. Shift-click to clear it.
